limitations: Concentrations are reported in pg/L as stored in the atlas; the question phrased them as ng/mL (1 ng/mL = 1000 pg/L).
The median is taken over all measurements per gene before log10 transformation; a log10 of the median is not the same as the median of log10 values.
Tissue enrichment is based on RNA (mRNA) classification in the atlas, not on protein-level enrichment.
The scatter and bar charts use the median concentration per gene; individual replicate measurements are not shown.
